posts.text: As president of the Dove Fund in Charleston, Amy Forney connects those in need with housing and brings hope to families across South Carolina. Her compassion and determination were recently on full display when she helped a man experiencing homelessness secure low-income housing after taking the time to build trust and connect him with the resources he needed. Amy is changing lives across the Lowcountry! #SCSweetTea

Please join me in praying for her family, friends, and the entire Lexington County Sheriff's Department during this difficult time.
